title: Cohomology of a finite type graded module over f^*B~ is a finite B-module
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $B=\bigoplus_{k\ge0}B_k$ a commutative graded $A$-algebra (the $B_k$ are $A$-submodules with $B_kB_l\subseteq B_{k+l}$ and $1\in B_0$, the structure map $A\to B$ landing in $B_0$) which is a finite type $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and write $f^\sharp(a)\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ for the image of $a\in A$. Let $(\mathcal G_m)_{m\ge0}$ be quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], and for all $k,m\ge0$ and $b\in B_k$ let $\mu^{(m)}_b:\mathcal G_m\to\mathcal G_{m+k}$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], such that: (i) $\mu^{(m)}_{b+b'}=\mu^{(m)}_b+\mu^{(m)}_{b'}$ for $b,b'\in B_k$; (ii) $\mu^{(m+l)}_b\circ\mu^{(m)}_{b'}=\mu^{(m)}_{bb'}$ for $b\in B_k$, $b'\in B_l$; (iii) for $a\in A$ with image $a\cdot1\in B_0$, $\mu^{(m)}_{a\cdot1}$ is multiplication by $f^\sharp(a)$ on $\mathcal G_m$; (iv) (finite type) $X$ is covered by open sets $U$ for each of which there are finitely many integers $d_1,\dots,d_r\ge0$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal G_{d_i}(U)$ such that for every $m\ge0$, every open $V\subseteq U$ and every $t\in\mathcal G_m(V)$, each point of $V$ has an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq V$ on which $t|_W=\sum_{i:\,d_i\le m}\sum_jc_{ij}\,\mu^{(d_i)}_{b_{ij}}(s_i)|_W$ for finitely many $c_{ij}\in\mathcal O_X(W)$ and $b_{ij}\in B_{m-d_i}$. (These data are the same as a quasi-coherent graded module $\bigoplus_m\mathcal G_m$ of finite type over the graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra $f^*\widetilde B$, $b\in B_k$ acting through its pulled-back global section.) Fix $p\ge0$ and put $M_m=H^p(X,\mathcal G_m)$ (sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]). Then $M=\bigoplus_{m\ge0}M_m$ is a $B$-module under $\big(\sum_kb_k\big)\cdot(x_m)_{m\ge0}=\big(\sum_{k+m=n}H^p(X,\mu^{(m)}_{b_k})(x_m)\big)_{n\ge0}$ ($b_k\in B_k$, $x_m\in M_m$, almost all zero), and $M$ is a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0897 (lemma-graded-finiteness), part (1), with the graded f^*B~-module of finite type written out through the action of the homogeneous elements of B (the B-module structure of H^p(X, F) that Stacks calls 'the graded B-module H^p(X, F)', with H^p(X, (+)_m G_m) = (+)_m H^p(X, G_m)). Stacks' proof: X' = Spec(B) x_{Spec A} X -> Spec(B) is proper (Morphisms 01W4), B Noetherian (Algebra 00FN), X' Noetherian (Morphisms 01T6), X' is the relative spectrum of f^*B~ (Constructions 01LX), F = pi_* F' with F' coherent (Morphisms 01SB, Lemma 01XZ), H^p(X, F) = H^p(X', F') (Lemma 089W), and Lemma 02O6. Tags verified in tags/tags: 0897, 01W4, 00FN, 01T6, 01LX, 01SB, 01XZ, 089W, 02O6.
